what_it_does.summary: DEFAULT OFF. For B-v2v and R-v2v a registered fraction (practice_fraction, proposal 0.25 => 6 of the 24 PPO episodes of one update) of each update's PPO episodes start from snapshots of the arm's OWN admitted within-seed cooperative bank examples instead of fresh t=300 starts. A-v2v is unchanged (A keeps its 24 normal episodes; it only supplies the matched safety references).
what_it_does.snapshot_and_seed: The episode is a restart of the example's decision snapshot through the REGISTERED sumo_verify.VerifyController ('policy continues' branch semantics): exact prefix replay with the sealed prefix fingerprint check, the snapshot's own t0 command, CRN generator restore at t0 (seed-1 examples: the stored snapshot generator state; seed-2 examples: replay_bank.replicate(snapshot, verification_id); extra-seed examples seed_index>=3: replicate(snapshot, 'salt#sN')), committed snapshot plans continue, no new plan is ever proposed.
what_it_does.policy_from_t0: CAVs are controlled by the CURRENT training policy from t0 (the job carries the same weights the update's normal episodes carry; v2v/intent observation wrappers apply exactly as in every other v2v controller). PPO/viability/routing see only the strictly post-t0 seconds (practice_starts.strip_steps): the replayed prefix seconds (<= t0, including the snapshot's t0 command) carry recorded behaviour-policy data and never become training steps.
what_it_does.horizon_reward_charge: Normal 1200 s horizon stop and normal per-second team-J reward; every practice episode is charged sim_s=1200 in the SAME phase (v2v_train) through the SAME hooks as normal episodes (reserve -> admission -> episode -> failure replacement over the ONE batch wave). A failed practice episode is replaced by a normal fresh start in the same cell (accel_runner.replacement_job strips the snapshot state) and the batch failure accounting (>20%/3-consecutive escalation) applies to the WHOLE batch.
what_it_does.matched_a_safety_reference: For EACH practice episode, v2v_live.safety also runs ONE matched A-policy reference episode: the SAME snapshot and CRN seed (same branch prefix replay and t0 generator restore), A's update-u policy from t0, no guide, frozen 'pa' slot ids, charged 1200 sim-s to the arm's practice cost (v2v_train) through the same wave hooks as one batch wave. The exact pairs feed the composite safety comparison (collisions/teleports hard constraints, critical_total CI) and the paired hard-brake bootstrap; practice episodes are additionally subject to live_safety per tick exactly like every guided episode. Missing reference fails closed.
what_it_does.sampling: Uniform over the eligible examples with a per-example repeat cap per update (practice_repeat_cap, registered values 1 or 2); deterministic RNG digest(practice=plan|arm|update|training_seed|fraction|cap). The sampled plan is sealed once (replay_bank/<ARM>/PRACTICE_PLAN_<ARM>_<UUU>.json, practice_plan_sha256) and FROZEN: process restarts reuse the same rows/job ids and never re-sample even if the bank grows.
what_it_does.r_fallback: Documented: R's plan count is B's REALISED practice count of the same update (never the requested count); R's cooperative pool first counts examples x repeat-cap (registry cooperative_capacity) and only a count beyond that capacity is filled from R's OTHER ADMITTED examples (rows flagged fallback=true); B never falls back.
what_it_does.empty_bank: Empty or unresolvable bank (BankDataMissing) -> plan with zero rows -> a full normal 24-episode wave. Bank examples are the arm's own-bank decisions only (own replay_bank links; imported u3 labels are never practice starts).
what_it_does.receipts_and_report: Each practice episode RESULT.json carries a practice block (practice=true, a_reference=false, verification_id, example_id, seed_index, t0, slot, snapshot_sha256, CRN provenance, fallback, charged_sim_s; never the snapshot itself); each matched A reference carries the same block with a_reference=true. The per-update receipt <ARM>_UPDATE_<UUU>.json gains a 'practice' block ONLY when the option is ON: practice vs normal episode counts (the REALISED practice count is what R matches), distinct examples used with repeat counts, mean returns vs normal (per episode and per control second), per-episode rows.
what_it_does.per_update_sim_s_rule: Per B/R update: 24 arm episodes at 1200 sim-s (6 practice replace 6 normal episodes, delta 0) PLUS one matched A reference per practice episode at 1200 sim-s each => +practice_count*1200 = +7200 sim-s per B/R update (A unchanged). Full-run upper bound quoted: reference quote = 2 arms x 24 updates x 6 x 1200 = 345600 sim-s; prepare_intent(ON) raises the runtime's shared v2v_train allocation to V2V_PHASES['v2v_train']+345600 and each B/R dispatch's launch3 quote adds practice_count*1200 per remaining update.

practice_fraction.meaning: fraction of the update's 24 PPO episodes that start from snapshots (0.25 => 6, and 6 matched A references per update)

how_to_enable_at_an_update_boundary: 1. Let the running V2V arms finish update k and pause at the boundary (WARM_<ARM>_PAUSED.json / resume_update=k as for any resume).

2. Produce the new runtime config: v2v_runner.prepare_intent(base, root=..., legacy_root=..., source_root=..., common_checkpoint_sha256=..., practice_starts=True) - practice_fraction/practice_repeat_cap default to the registered 0.25/2; B and R keys are identical by construction; the runtime's v2v_train allocation covers the quoted matched A-reference upper bound (V2V_PHASES v2v_train + 345600 sim-s).

3. Re-register the launch identity for the new V2V_RUNTIME.json: the launch3 gate/binding flow (gate PASS for the exact deployed commit, runtime_sha256 in a new additive LAUNCH3 binding, check_hold) exactly as at first launch; v2v_launch3.bind_runtime validates the ON values (B == R, registered fraction/cap) instead of pinning them.

4. Re-run the launch3 preflight and re-dispatch the train children with resume_update=k (v2v_live.spawn('train', arm)); the launch3 quote for each B/R child adds the matched A-reference cost (practice_count*1200 per remaining update). The first update each B/R child trains is update k+1; its practice plan freezes at that boundary (replay_bank/<ARM>/PRACTICE_PLAN_<ARM>_<k+1:03>.json).

5. Verify per update in <ARM>_UPDATE_<UUU>.json['practice'] (practice/normal counts, examples, returns vs normal) and the per-episode receipt flags in jobs/<id>/RESULT.json['practice']; the matched A references appear as jobs/<ns>_warm_u<UUU>_<ARM>_practiceref_pa<NN>_A_<seed>/RESULT.json with a_reference=true and feed <ARM>_SAFETY_COMPOSITE_<UUU>.json. Turning it OFF again repeats the same steps with practice_starts=False; plans already frozen stay on disk as history.

Charge note: per B/R update the practice episodes replace 6 normal episodes (delta 0) and the matched A references add practice_count*1200 = 7200 sim-s (quoted above; upper bound over the full run 345600 sim-s).
